toolCall.argumentsJson:
{"CommandLine":"# Get overall CPU load
$cpu = Get-CimInstance Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_Processor | Where-Object Name -eq "_Total" | Select-Object PercentProcessorTime

# Get Memory stats
$os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem
$totalRam = [math]::Round($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize / 1MB, 2)
$freeRam = [math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory / 1MB, 2)
$usedRam = $totalRam - $freeRam

# Get top processes by CPU
$topProcs = Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name, @{Name="CPU(s)";Expression={[math]::Round($_.CPU, 2)}}, @{Name="RAM(MB)";Expression={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet / 1MB, 2)}}

Write-Host "--- SYSTEM STATUS ---"
Write-Host "CPU Load: $($cpu.PercentProcessorTime)%"
Write-Host "RAM Used: $usedRam GB / $totalRam GB ($freeRam GB Free)"
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "--- TOP PROCESSES ---"
$topProcs | Format-Table -AutoSize","Cwd":"c:\AI-BS","WaitMsBeforeAsync":5000,"toolAction":"Checking system performance metrics","toolSummary":"Check system performance"}
